en.title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
en.hook: Discover how a production agent coordinates narrative decomposition, rendering, and revision for long-horizon video generation.
key_takeaways: Multi-agent coordination for narrative decomposition and state tracking
Automated pipeline integrating shot design and prompt construction
Self-improving mechanism to enhance rendering and revision quality

zh.title: CineForge：用于长周期视频生成的自我改进智能体
zh.hook: 了解如何通过生产智能体协调叙事分解、渲染和修订，实现长周期故事驱动的视频生成。
key_takeaways: 多智能体协同进行叙事分解与状态追踪
集成镜头设计与提示词构建的自动化流水线
通过自我改进机制提升渲染和修改质量
